status: PROVISIONAL coarse full-cap geometric visibility demo
value_definition: geometrically visible fraction of projected apparent disc area
limitations: 9.6 km map spacing; 200 m terrain locally, 960 m exterior supporting terrain.
150 km finite ray search, 1 degree horizon azimuth sampling; narrow obstacles may be missed.
Disc area sampled with 128 points; fraction quantization 1/128; thin slivers may be missed.
Apparent target positions inferred from IM-2 ephemerides and angular diameters; shared-vector approximation.
No eclipses, solar flux, Earth phase, atmosphere, DSN visibility or communications budget.
2 m observer height is an assumption; unresolved local obstacles are not represented.
Nearest coarse cell readouts; not operational landing safety or battery certification.
